Gunspike.name: Cannon Spike
Gunspike.summary: Cannon Spike (released in Japan as Gunspike) is a top-down run-and-gun shooting game developed by Psikyo & published by Capcom in the year 2000. Players select from a roster of classic Capcom characters, then play through a series of short stages & boss battles in a randomly selected order.

World Neverland Plus - The Olerud Kingdo.name: World Neverland: Olerud Oukoku Monogatari
World Neverland Plus - The Olerud Kingdo.summary:
The first installment of the World Neverland series. Players are invited to "experience of fiction life".

World Neverland: Olerun Oukoku Monogatari is the first game in the World Neverland series. The game takes places in a fictional world in which the characters make friends, fall in love, get married, have children, do jobs, and grow old. In the game, the player's character can learn swordplay, martial arts, and magic to increase their stats. There are about 120 different people living in the game's world. The player's choices have a significant impact on the overall story of the game.

Yukigatari.name: Yukigatari
Yukigatari.summary: Originally released for PC (Windows) platform as hentai visual novel in 2001, this Dreamcast port removes adult content, adds renewed artwork and new scenario events.
